We booked relaxation massages for our family and were initially offered a discounted package price of 2 hours each. However, after booking, the reception staff repeatedly called and sent WhatsApp messages asking for advance payment—even after we clearly explained that we would pay in person since we were visiting from abroad and had no other payment method available.

Later, we suddenly received multiple messages saying the discounted price would not be honored on weekends, despite the fact that they had already confirmed our appointments for Saturday. When we visited the spa in person, the staff member covering for the manager was unable to reach him. To her credit, she contacted the area manager, who then agreed to honor the discounted price. She was polite, professional, and genuinely tried to help, even offering an extra 30 minutes of dry massage as goodwill.

My wife and daughter had a good experience, but unfortunately mine was extremely disappointing. Despite requesting to stay with the same therapist, I was passed between three different massage therapists. About 20–30 minutes were wasted during these changes. When I requested that the lost time be compensated, no one responded. After waiting a long time, I eventually had to leave and even ended up taking a cold shower before exiting.

What disturbed me most was being made uncomfortable by being offered “extra services” during the session—something I was completely unaware of and not expecting in a professional spa setting. This left me shocked and deeply uncomfortable. I don’t blame the individual therapists, but it appears they may be encouraged to make such offers, which is unacceptable.

Overall, the experience felt disorganized, unprofessional, and disappointing. Sadly, I would not recommend this place.

featured_reviews.name: Viral Bhatt
featured_reviews.review_text: My wife and I had been thinking of getting a Spa Therapy because of the stiffness in our bodies that we had been experiencing since a long time now just after we woke up everymorning. Guess that's what happens to people like us with desk jobs and a very sedentary lifestyle. Finally, the day came on 16th Feb, when I ran a half marathon (21 Km) at Hiranandani Thane. Now, anybody who has ran a half/full marathon knows the toll it takes on your body. I thought, what better day then today to get a full body Spa treatment? I had been recommended Blue Bells by my cousin who had been there before and vouched for the genuineness and quality of the therapy he had there. So we reached the conveniently located Blue Bells Thai Spa at Goregaon, which is on the S.V. Road, just a few meters from Goregaon railway station. We reached there early (better to space it at least an hour before or after meals) and probably were the first customers that day. First impression after looking at the menu is definitely the competitive prices that we saw - they were definitely a lot lower than what we're used to looking at the big banner ads. I mean in retrospect, I genuinely feel that they are providing a definite value-for-money. We both selected Balinese Therapy - because it suited our need for a hard and heavy message (there were others in the hard and soft category too). My wife was assigned the therapist Lisa and I was assigned Achui (hope I'm spelling it correctly). They were professional and knew what they were doing. I hadn't told my therapist that I ran a half marathon the same morning but just by gliding her hands over all the pain points, she just knew intuitively where to put more effort. One suggestion for everyone - ask for the pillow to be removed if you're uncomfortable like I was as it's not my natural sleeping posture. At the end of the Therapy, Achui sensed the pain on my calves and thighs and offered to apply pain relieving balm too. The post-therapy shower was clean and well maintained too. Go for a hot-water shower and you'll know what bliss is it, post the therapy. They offered green tea after concluding the session. I couldn't have asked for more. Do not forget to tip the therapist. If you're feeling awkward to do it in the therapy room, you can ask for the therapist to be called at the reception and appreciate their hardwork and professionalism by tipping appropriately there itself, like we did. I'm definitely recommending them to everyone I know and looking forward for another excuse to go and visit them again. Thanks to the therapy, I recovered from the body pain sooner than I had expected and my wife too is planning another trip with her gang of girls soon! (Her friends too can't believe the price at which this excellent service is being provided.) We're glad to have found a genuine Thai Spa with quality service. Keep up the good work Blue Bells! You earned 2 new customers for sure.
